name: portfolio-prompts
description: Session-lifecycle skills for the test-automation portfolio: onboarding, status, worklists, reviews, implementation logs, handovers, close-out, portfolio fan-outs, and repository analysis.

interface.longDescription: Install reusable workflows for onboarding, planning, executing, reviewing, documenting, reporting, and closing test-automation portfolio projects.
defaultPrompt: Use $portfolio-prompts:portfolio-status to report the current portfolio state.
Use $portfolio-prompts:resume-session to resume work on a named project.
Use $portfolio-prompts:analyze-repo to analyse an unfamiliar repository.
